sources.interpretation: 학교에서처럼만 exemplifies stacked particles. 친구와 같이 and 친구하고 같이 contain a separate adverb. This does not transfer case stacking to particle 같이.

supported.evidence: 에서 is directly attested by NIKL and KAIST; 에 is directly attested by KAIST 전에처럼. Short locative 서 is an explicit compositional inference from KRDict 86712, not a quoted 서처럼 example.
supported.composition: Plural 들, nominalizing 기, and existing outer focus/topic/polite particles retain their roles. These composition probes are not presented as quotations. Whole-word and nominal lexical hypotheses remain available.
supported.excluded: No case repetition, case-before-같이 generalization, cross-token parsing, or spelling/spacing repair.

observations.reason: Source surface and annotation disagree. Preserve both without requiring a repair or forbidding future explicitly scoped correction.
Unrelated source row has 을 after a vowel. Retained literally; not evidence to relax the object-particle allomorph.
학교서처럼/집서처럼 compose the dictionary’s locative 서 with the reviewed comparison chain. Independent Korean review remains pending.

Raw rules also produce 학교에+서+처럼 and 먹어+서+처럼 with hypothetical nominal heads, and 읽하다+기+에서+처럼 via existing shortening. These are not certified by passing required judgments. The full validity review queue and raw additions are preserved.
Two existing KAIST test misses, 청에서처럼 and 문명세계에서처럼, become matches after the independently implemented NIKL/training-backed rule. No frozen baseline or test rows changed.

The packaged screenshot preserves two words but the default whole-word 같이 gloss is the transliterated gachi. Short 서 also displays its combined homonym label. Morphological separation does not select the intended contextual dictionary sense; this remains contextual ranking work, not a claim of a translated sentence.
